database.maintainer: MariaDB Foundation / MariaDB plc (Docker Official Image)

runtime.authentication: native BookStack standard authentication and users; Platform role is not a BookStack role
runtime.session: pl_bookstack_session scoped by APP_URL to /wiki; native CSRF/authorization
runtime.bootstrap: generated root-owned private mode0600 files; initial admin admin@pl.invalid; password file never in source/API/argv
runtime.data: owned database volume /var/lib/mysql and config/uploads/attachments/sessions volume /config
runtime.secrets: APP_KEY plus database/root/admin passwords generated per instance; app key persists across enable
runtime.network: owned per-instance network for web and database; web alone joins existing core ingress; no DB host port
runtime.resource_budget: 2 x 512 MiB, 1 CPU, 256 pids; writable rootfs required by upstream init; no privileged/socket/host paths
runtime.wrapper_lineage: Pinned LinuxServer BookStack software and native MariaDB retained; Pl adds only private initial administrator bootstrap after native migrations.

required_acceptance: pinned image availability/provenance and native BookStack/PHP/MariaDB version readback
fresh migrations and generated initial administrator login; no upstream default password exposed
native user creation, permissions, books/chapter/pages and editor save/reload
image and attachment upload/download through /wiki/ with native permissions
native session cookie Path/Secure/HttpOnly, CSRF, native logout and Platform gate logout
disable/enable and host restart preserve database, files, users and APP_KEY
interrupted install/remove retries; foreign container/volume/file/image/network rejection
Pl proxy prefix assets, redirects, encoded names, download/upload body limits; no runtime claim from static checks
